text:
Ah, failure, that delightful dance partner!  

You see it lurking in the shadows, a hunchbacked jester with a mocking grin, whispering tales of dashed hopes and crushed dreams. But fear not, noble friend! For failure is but a costume, a disguise for the grandest of transformations!

When the world throws a pie in your face, don't wipe it off with a scowl. Embrace the sticky mess!  Laugh! Twirl! Use it to build a magnificent meringue pie sculpture, a monument to your resilience!

For what is a setback but a springboard? It launches us into the air, providing a thrilling view of the world from a new and unexpected angle.  

So, when the world says, "Nay," shout, "Encore!"

And remember, dear friend, even the greatest jesters stumble and fall. It's what we do next that truly matters.  We dust ourselves off, adjust our bells, and dance on, ever-so-slightly more wobbly, but with a twinkle in our eye.

Now, if you'll excuse me, I see a giant, inflatable banana about to fall on my head.  Wish me luck! Or don't. The fall is part
